mapper.insert: insert into tbl_member (member_email, member_phone, member_password, member_name, member_alias, member_bio, member_status) values (#{memberEmail}, #{memberPhone}, #{memberPassword}, #{memberName}, #{memberAlias}, #{memberBio}, #{memberStatus})
mapper.select: select id, member_email, member_phone, member_password, member_name, member_alias, member_bio, member_status, created_datetime, updated_datetime from tbl_member where id = #{id}
